title: Beautiful male cat
description:
Name : zatar (Arabian origins name)
Age :7-8 months
Traits : extremely active, athletic, has two personalities (cute-playful) and he is really unusually smart. 
Fully vaccinated
Neutered
Very soft fur
Loves different kinds of food as he is not a picky eater

Past problems that got solved:
He has urinary problems but got resolved with proper food regime for a specific time. 

Warning: even though this is an extremely adorable cat, he really does need exceptional amount of daily entertainment because he is bit different than local cats and shirazi ones as he is a mix between them. If he doesnt play enough daily he will start breaking stuff and opening drawers maybe and sometimes climb curtains even (i even had manually teach him not to do that). 

Reason i wanted to give him away : he is very energetic and needs to have a home with another cats because he needs to play with someone and if he doesnt find cats to play with he will play with humans. I dont have enough space for him to run around, which is also why i recommend someone with spacious interior. 
I would recommend zatar for someone who wants a playful cat, not a relaxing one.

Name : zatar (Arabian origins name)
Age :7-8 months
Traits : extremely active, athletic, has two personalities (cute-playful) and he is really unusually smart. 
Fully vaccinated
Neutered
Very soft fur
Loves different kinds of food as he is not a picky eater

Past problems that got solved:
He has urinary problems but got resolved with proper food regime for a specific time. 

Warning: even though this is an extremely adorable cat, he really does need exceptional amount of daily entertainment because he is bit different than local cats and shirazi ones as he is a mix between them. If he doesnt play enough daily he will start breaking stuff and opening drawers maybe and sometimes climb curtains even (i even had manually teach him not to do that). 

Reason i wanted to give him away : he is very energetic and needs to have a home with another cats because he needs to play with someone and if he doesnt find cats to play with he will play with humans. I dont have enough space for him to run around, which is also why i recommend someone with spacious interior. 
I would recommend zatar for someone who wants a playful cat, not a relaxing one.

description:

​المواصفات والتفاصيل:
​القياس: حوض مكعب متناسق بمقاس 30 \times 30 \times 30 سم. 
​الحالة: الحوض نظيف جداً وسليم تماماً بدون أي تسريب نهائياً. 
​التربة: أرضية مميزة تجمع بين اللونين الأبيض والأسود لتعطي تبايناً جميلاً يبرز ألوان الكائنات المائية. 
​الديكور الطبيعي: مزود بصخور مرجانية مثقبة (تساعد على نمو البكتيريا النافعة والحفاظ على البيئة الحيوية والبارامترات الطبيعية المستقرة للماء). 
​النباتات: يحتوي على نباتات طبيعية حية تساهم في تنقية المياه وتوفير بيئة صحية. 
​الحوض منسق بعناية وبمظهر متوازن وطبيعي جداً. 
For sale: A beautifully maintained and fully established nano cube aquarium, perfectly sized and ready to go. Ideal for shrimp keeping (like Red Cherry shrimp) or small nano fish. 
​Specifications & Details:
​Dimensions: Perfect cube size, 30 \times 30 \times 30 cm. 
​Condition: Very clean and perfectly sealed—guaranteed 100% leak-free. 
​Substrate: A striking dual-tone black and white gravel setup, creating a beautiful contrast that makes shrimp and fish colors pop. 
​Natural Decor: Equipped with porous coral rocks (excellent for hosting beneficial bacteria, maintaining a healthy bio-system, and stabilizing natural water parameters). 
​Plants: Features live natural aquatic plants that help purify the water and provide a healthy, eco-friendly habitat. 
​The tank is meticulously scaped with a very balanced and natural look.

title: Free adoption
description:
Lily and Safrino 

Lily and Safrino, two adorable little sisters, are among the sweetest and gentlest kittens you could ever meet. 

Last week, in the middle of the night, I rescued them from a large group of adult cats that were attacking and chasing them. They were completely abandoned, with no mother to protect them. I brought them home to keep them safe, and they've been thriving ever since. 

They are about 3 months old, have quickly learned to use the litter box, and love to eat, play, and sleep—just like any kitten who finally feels safe and loved. They are incredibly gentle, affectionate, and not aggressive at all. 

I wish I could keep them, but I already have three rescued cats at home, all of whom were injured when I found them. Unfortunately, I can no longer provide a permanent home for Lily and Safrino, despite how much I care about them. 

I am hoping with all my heart that a kind and loving family will adopt them. They don't need anything extravagant—just a safe home, or even a secure yard with shelter, regular food, and someone who will care for them so they never have to live in fear again. 

If you can adopt, foster, or even share this post, you could truly change their lives. They deserve the chance to grow up knowing love, safety, and kindness. 

Please help Lily and Safrino find the forever home they deserve.
